name: factory
description: An orchestrator skill that takes a request through an interactive scope, then runs scope-review, build, and ship as unattended phases, judging each phase's completion itself and repairing or relaunching it on failure, ending in a pull request or a report. Use on Claude Code or Codex when you want a request carried through to a shipped change without a human at each phase.

interface.shortDescription: Run scope, scope-review, build, and ship unattended.
